pairs: Igitur post hæc consuluit David Dominum,
And so, after these things, David consulted the Lord,
Num ascendam in unam de civitatibus Juda?
“Shall I ascend to one of the cities of Judah?”
And the Lord said to him,
And David said, “To where shall I ascend?”
Ascendit ergo David, et duæ uxores ejus,
Therefore, David ascended with his two wives,
and Abigail, the wife of Nabal of Carmel.
sed et viros, qui erant cum eo,
And as for the men who were with him,
duxit David singulos cum domo sua:
David led forth each man with his household.
And they stayed in the towns of Hebron.
And the men of Judah went and anointed David there,
et unxerunt ibi David ut regnaret super domum Juda.
so that he would reign over the house of Judah.
Et nuntiatum est David quod viri Jabes Galaad sepelissent Saul.
And it was reported to David that the men of Jabesh Gilead had buried Saul.
Misit ergo David nuntios ad viros Jabes Galaad,
Therefore, David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead,
qui fecistis misericordiam hanc cum domino vestro Saul,
who has accomplished this mercy with your lord Saul,
so that you would bury him.
Et nunc retribuet vobis quidem Dominus misericordiam
the Lord will repay to you mercy and truth.
But I also will act with favor,
because you have accomplished this word.
licet enim mortuus sit dominus vester Saul,
For even though your lord Saul has died,
tamen me unxit domus Juda in regem sibi.
still the house of Judah has anointed me as king over them.”
Then Abner, the son of Ner,
the leader of the army of Saul,
took Ishbosheth, the son of Saul,
and he led him around, throughout the camp.
And he appointed him as king over Gilead,
Quadraginta annorum erat Isboseth filius Saul cum regnare cœpisset super Israël,
Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, was forty years old when he had begun to rule over Israel.
And he reigned for two years.
sola autem domus Juda sequebatur David.
For only the house of Judah followed David.
Et fuit numerus dierum quos commoratus est David imperans in Hebron super domum Juda,
And the number of the days,
during which David was staying and ruling in Hebron over the house of Judah,
was seven years and six months.
Egressusque est Abner filius Ner, et pueri Isboseth filii Saul, de castris in Gabaon.
And Abner, the son of Ner, and the youths of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul, went out from the camp to Gibeon.
Therefore, Joab, the son of Zeruiah,
et occurrerunt eis juxta piscinam Gabaon.
went out and met them beside the pool of Gibeon.
And when they had convened together,
they sat down opposite one another:
these on one side of the pool,
and those on the other side.
et transierunt numero duodecim de Benjamin,
they rose up and crossed over, twelve in number of Benjamin,
from the side of Ishbosheth, the son of Saul,
and twelve of the youths of David.
taking hold of his peer by the head,
fixed a sword into the side of his adversary,
And the name of that place was called:
The Field of the Valiant in Gibeon.
Et ortum est bellum durum satis in die illa:
And a very harsh war rose up on that day. And Abner,
fugatusque est Abner et viri Israël a pueris David.
with the men of Israel, was put to flight by the youths of David.
Erant autem ibi tres filii Sarviæ,
Now the three sons of Zeruiah were in that place:
And Asahel was a very swift runner,
quasi unus de capreis quæ morantur in silvis.
like one of the deer that lives in the forest.
et non declinavit ad dextram neque ad sinistram omittens persequi Abner.
and he did not turn aside to the right, nor to the left, to cease in the pursuit of Abner.
Respexit itaque Abner post tergum suum,
And so, Abner looked behind his back, and he said,
and apprehend one of the youths,
and take his spoils for yourself.”
Noluit autem Asaël omittere quin urgeret eum.
But Asahel was not willing to cease from pursuing him closely.
Rursumque locutus est Abner ad Asaël:
And again, Abner said to Asahel: “Withdraw,
and do not choose to follow me.
ne compellar confodere te in terram,
Otherwise, I will be compelled to stab you to the ground,
et levare non potero faciem meam ad Joab fratrem tuum.
and I will not be able to lift up my face before your brother, Joab.”
But he disdained to heed him,
and he was not willing to turn aside.
percussit ergo eum Abner aversa hasta in inguine,
Therefore, turning, Abner struck him with his spear in the groin,
et transfodit, et mortuus est in eodem loco:
and he pierced him through, and he died in the same place.
omnesque qui transibant per locum illum,
And all those who would pass by the place,
in quo ceciderat Asaël et mortuus erat,
in which Asahel had fallen and died,
Persequentibus autem Joab et Abisai fugientem Abner,
Now while Joab and Abishai were pursuing Abner as he fled,
et venerunt usque ad collem aquæductus,
And they went as far as the Hill of the Aqueduct,
qui est ex adverso vallis itineris deserti in Gabaon.
which is opposite the valley on the way of the desert in Gibeon.
Congregatique sunt filii Benjamin ad Abner:
And the sons of Benjamin gathered themselves to Abner.
And being joined in one battle line,
they stood at the summit of a hill.
And Abner cried out to Joab,
Num usque ad internecionem tuus mucro desæviet?
“Will your sword rage unto utter destruction?
an ignoras quod periculosa sit desperatio?
Are you ignorant that it is perilous to act in desperation?
usquequo non dicis populo ut omittat persequi fratres suos?
How long will you not tell the people to cease from the pursuit of their brothers?”
if you had spoken in the morning,
mane recessisset populus persequens fratrem suum.
the people would have withdrawn from pursuing their brothers.”
and the entire army stood still,
and they did not pursue after Israel any more,
and they did not engage in conflict.
Then Abner and his men went away,
et viri ejus abierunt per campestria,
and having roamed throughout all of Beth-horon,
returning after he had released Abner,
et defuerunt de pueris David decem
Servi autem David percusserunt de Benjamin,
But of Benjamin and of the men who were with Abner,
et de viris qui erant cum Abner, trecentos sexaginta,
the servants of David had struck three hundred and sixty,
et sepelierunt eum in sepulchro patris sui in Bethlehem:
and they buried him in the sepulcher of his father at Bethlehem.
et ambulaverunt tota nocte Joab et viri qui erant cum eo,
And Joab, and the men who were with him, walked throughout the night,
et in ipso crepusculo pervenerunt in Hebron.
and they arrived in Hebron at the very break of day.
